title: Summit Tier Uplift on Crestline Companion Phone Fee Refunds
content:
A phone booking fee refund on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product is raised by a status uplift that follows the current tier of the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program:

| Current Summit tier | Status uplift |
|---|---|
| Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman | adds 20 percent |
| Summit Gold or Summit Platinum | adds 10 percent |
| any other tier | adds nothing |

**Hypothetical case.** A Summit Diamond holder receives an uplift of 20 percent; a Summit Member receives none.
